findings.subject: stale research unittest count in CI evidence descriptor
findings.rationale: The descriptor now records the directly verified controlling-run count of 463. The CI run and its log remain the execution authority.

findings.subject: candidate nonce and approval/preflight hashes are not independently re-derived by the parser
findings.rationale: The exact candidate is constrained by operator-only construction, strict validation, dual-consumer byte-identical validation, exclusive install, readback, unused identities, and unused roots. Re-derivation can be added in a future authority generation.

findings.subject: boolean-for-zero equality on position and historical master delta
findings.rationale: The sole production builder emits canonical integer zero, exact candidate/install identity prevents mutation after consumer validation, and both fields are frozen zero semantics. A future parser revision should route both through strict plain-integer validation.

findings.subject: two-phase installer relies on successful validation process exit rather than additionally checking report schema and PASS
findings.rationale: The consumers emit reports only after successful strict validation, subprocess failure is load-bearing, and candidate SHA and role are checked. Explicit report schema/PASS checks are future hardening.

findings.subject: mutation-label naming drift between qualification evidence and tests
findings.rationale: All 25 declared mutation semantics map one-to-one to executed tests and pass; the drift is labels only.

findings.subject: unused live identity scan is production-scope-only and limited to the two authoritative banking roots
findings.rationale: Those two roots are the only declared live identity authorities; synthetic reuse is intentional and cannot mint production authority. Broader indexing is future hardening.
